evidence.quote: We propose a $40 million class fund and $8 million in separately paid fees and expenses, subject to court approval.
Your proposal totals $48 million, which exceeds Brightline’s $40 million all-in settlement authority.
We are open to discussing the allocation within the overall limit.
we propose using your stated $40 million overall limit to provide a $34 million class fund and up to $6 million

summary: Plaintiff first raised fees in its opening public proposal, before class relief was settled. The transcript explicitly ties the fee and class-fund numbers to an overall settlement cap and allocation within that cap. There is no clear evidence that plaintiff prioritized its own fee over the class, that defense exploited fee interests, that a reverse auction occurred, or that the court declaration was misleading.
